title: Highly-resolved nitrogen load to surface water from farmland ammonia emissions in Southeastern China
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00304D, Paper
Zaili Ling, Jiayi Xin, Tao Huang, Chaopu Ti, Lingyun Peng, Jianmin Ma
Ammonia (NH₃) emissions from agriculture significantly impact aquatic ecosystems through the deposition of ammonia nitrogen (NHx-N). Models established on a gridded map provide a useful tool to investigate NH3 dispersion...
